title: Framework SQL built from input (djangoraw) — review required
description: A djangoraw data call assembles SQL from parts: M.objects.raw("SELECT " + c). Framework helpers do not sanitize interpolated values. This lexical rule flags the assembly; the reviewer confirms every part is trusted or parameterizes it.
remediation: Use the framework's binding (parameter lists); never interpolate values.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any assembled query matches, including trusted ones.
